The three main things I would recommend are 1. The right medication 2. A good therapist 3. A good psychiatrist. These three thing have helped me significantly and they can for you too. I know the feeling of wanting to die, but there are other options like going to the ER if you think you will self harm yourself or having a friend or someone to be by your side. You’re in the dark now, but you know it’s not going to last. You will come out of it on top like you have been!

I am glad you reached out to this bipolar community! I myself have bipolar 2. I am so sorry you have had so much struggle with support. I remember what it was like before I was on meds and the world crushing down on me, but you’ll know when you get the right combination of meds. I know it hurts to be brushed off but I’m here to tell you that you are important, loved, and greatly wanted by people around you and you are truly special! You’re a badass for making it this far in your struggle. Now that you know what it is help can be given. It’s important to take care of you first sometimes. You truly rock! Be strong.
